events.title: Update: Full controller support, new map markers and special attacks
events.summary: Play everything with a controller From the title screen to the last verdict, everything now works with a controller: menus, tutorial, character creation, inventory, merchants, quest givers and the entire court session. PlayStation and Nintendo controllers are recognized and show their own buttons. The tutorial cards show the buttons large and clear, including which ones to hold. Anyone who has ever walked from the castle to the Pirate Camp knows how big Dadi Kingdom is. From now on, saddled horses are waiting for you in eight locations. On top of that, order comes to the dungeon, and the faces before the throne may look rather familiar. events.title: Hotfix 0.0.1.0 – More Structure in the Kingdom
events.summary: A central part of this update focuses on access points and interactions throughout the kingdom. Certain door-related sequences have been further integrated, making routes and transitions feel clearer and more naturally connected to the gameplay flow. As a result, these moments feel less like isolated elements and more like part of one cohesive world.Another major step is the progress made on the day system. The daily cycle is now active in-game, giving the kingdom a much stronger sense of rhythm
